name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: By the sky and the night comer

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: And what can make you know what is the night comer

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: It is the piercing star

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: So let man observe from what he was created

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: He was created from a fluid, ejected

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
en: Then man will have no power or any helper

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: By the sky which returns [rain]

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: And [by] the earth which cracks open

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: And it is not amusement

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: Indeed, they are planning a plan

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: But I am planning a plan

name: At-Tariq · الطارق
en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: Who created and proportioned

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: And who destined and [then] guided

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: And who brings out the pasture

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: And [then] makes it black stubble

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
en: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: And We will ease you toward ease

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: But the wretched one will avoid it

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
en: Neither dying therein nor living

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

name: Al-A'la · الأعلى
en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays
